name: Potion of Growth

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: The Enlarge part of Enlarge/Reduce for 1d4 hours (no Concentration).
text: When you drink this potion, you gain the "enlarge" effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell for 1d4 hours (no Concentration needed): you grow one size, have Advantage on Strength checks and saves, and your weapons deal an extra 1d4 damage. The red in the liquid keeps expanding from a tiny bead to color the whole potion, then shrinks back.
